sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain unbeaten over the wider stretch with five wins and a draw before that defeat, and they will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom with just 4 points from 10 games and are on a run of five losses in their last six matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, welcome Eccleshall, who sit fifth; Eccleshall have picked up form recently with a win in their last outing, making this a competitive mid-table encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, travel to Wednesfield Community on Saturday before hosting Brereton Social on Wednesday evening—a busy midweek for the visitors. Bilston Town, sixth-placed, host Foley Meir at home on Saturday in a clash between two mid-table sides. Barnton travel to face Shawbury United, who are in poor form with six consecutive losses and occupy 15th place. Market Drayton Town, 10th, host New Mills, who are mid-table but inconsistent; meanwhile Cheadle Heath Nomads, 17th, visit Telford Town, 18th, in a fixture between two of the division's struggling sides. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home on Saturday, with both teams in the lower half seeking to climb the table. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday before their midweek trip to Wednesfield; Brereton are winless in recent outings and face a difficult double header against opponents including bottom-side Widnes.
